name: zhongshu
description: 中枢：管好你的模型账号，再让 AI agent 团队替你干活

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zhongshu/core -w @zhongshu/server && npm run build -w @zhongshu/web && npm run build -w @zhongshu/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/server apps/desktop && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @zhongshu/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && cd apps/desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
